decisions.statement: A line is filed into the file beside the page referenced.
A name reaching a page files a line carrying the naming page's own id.
An import files a line carrying the name of the file imported.
The page an imported file belongs to is asked of the index, as the reader beside it asks.
A line is filed only beside a page the reading has by its file or in the index.
A page naming the same page twice through one property files one line.
A name reaching no page is reported rather than filed.
A name a mortal page carries, or a name of a mortal page, is not reported.
A page's own identity files no line.
Only a body named `.ts` or `.tsx` files an import.

definition: the lines a page's own body files into the file beside every page it references
